name: – Victor Negrescu, Siegfried Mureşan – After § 19 – Am 18
title: REPORT on the implementation of the Recovery and Resilience Facility
part_text: 19a. Regrets the absence of a comprehensive and credible long-term repayment plan for NGEU liabilities, including clear annual projections, repayment mechanisms and contingencies; calls on the Commission to present such a plan without delay to ensure transparency, budgetary predictability and the long-term sustainability of the EU’s public finances;
